_comment: Pull Through (plan-portal-spells.md C2, D1/D4/D5/D7/D10): the mage-portal pair's other half. The same wind-up cast as Open Portal, but the doorway appears AT THE CASTER'S BOUND CAMPFIRE, and anyone who presses E on it and takes the row is delivered to wherever the caster is standing at that moment. Its niche is moving OTHER players to YOU (§1) - the group forming at the fire joins the caster who already walked out to the content; personal travel home already ships free as Recall, and Open Portal already covers travel TO the fire. SHAPE IS WIND-UP PLUS TTL, NOT A CHANNEL (D1), and the numbers are Open Portal's on purpose: a pair that costs and reads the same in both directions is one thing players learn once. castTicks 75 (2.5 s) with castInterruptedByDamage true is Recall's posture and buys the whole interrupt matrix plus cost-charged-only-on-completion. ⭐ maxLevel 1 IS THE DELIBERATE SHAPE, not a stub: the closed {1, 5, 10} vocabulary defines 1 as a binary ability with nothing to scale, and it keeps D7 honest with one line of arithmetic - with no ttlTicksPerLevel there is no max-level TTL to chase, so cooldownTicks 1200 clears cast 75 + TTL 900 = 975 and a second portal cannot coexist with the first. ⭐ THE EFFECT TYPE CARRIES THE ANCHOR GATE, so no requiresAnchor is authored here and none is authorable: `spawn_at_anchor` places its summon AT the anchor, so an unbound caster has nowhere to put anything, and the key is off the type's allowlist precisely so a `false` cannot suggest otherwise. That is the difference from open-portal.json, where the same flag IS authored because plain `spawn` is shared with FireTotem, which must keep working unbound. The press and the cast completion both refuse with the no-anchor reason. ⚑ Placement is a D8 rule, not a taste call: the portal lands on the sys.anchorSpawnOffset ring (2.5 u) and never inside any fire's bind circle, because the client synthesizes a campfire interact offer that OVERRIDES the server's - a portal inside the circle would lose every E press to the flight map. No unlock source, DELIBERATELY (D10): placement is a later PO call and the skill is SKILL-cheat granted for now, the FireVulnerability convention (a worked example awaiting the content pass, NOT one of the Omni test rigs that must never gain a source). ALL NUMBERS [PLACEHOLDER] per the GDD rule; the cost matches Open Portal's first guess and §10 item 13 is where the PO prices the pair after two-window play.
